title: Full-dimensional quantum scattering calculations of rovibrationally excited HD+HD collisions
summary: Full-dimensional quantum scattering calculations are reported for ro-vibrational transitions in HD+HD collisions using a highly accurate interaction potential for the H$_2$-H$_2$ system. Several near-resonant ro-vibrational transitions are identified that conserve the overall rotational angular momentum and nearly conserve the internal energy of the collision partners. Key anisotropic terms that drive the rotational transitions and angular momentum partial waves that contribute to low energy resonant features in the energy dependence of the cross sections are identified.
